# PalOrbit

> PalLaw Rules Studio is the free browser editor for PalLaw, a Palworld server rules mod.

## PalLaw Rules Studio

Draw regions on the World and World Tree maps, assign modes and schedules, edit player actions and combat permissions, validate a rulebook, and export PalLaw.json. Configuration stays in the browser. No account or configuration uploads are required.

- [PalLaw Rules Studio](https://pallaw.palorbit.app/)
- [Download PalLaw on Nexus Mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/palworld/mods/4193)
- [Configuration schema](https://pallaw.palorbit.app/pallaw/PalLaw.schema.json)
- [Example rulebook](https://pallaw.palorbit.app/pallaw/example.PalLaw.json)
- [Legal and map notices](https://pallaw.palorbit.app/legal/)
- [Full reference](https://pallaw.palorbit.app/llms-full.txt)

Maintained by Skick. Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Pocketpair. Palworld materials belong to their respective owners.
